authentication.nonEnterpriseKeyBoundary: The vendor states non-Enterprise keys have broad account access. The consumer enforces GET-only operation bounds; it does not claim a scoped key.

discovery.shape: data.resources contains operations and endpoint method/path metadata; only fixed capability booleans are projected. Scope listings, unknown endpoint strings and schemas are omitted.

pagination.shape: The final nextCursor is explicitly null. Non-final cursors are base64 strings, accepted only as bounded query parameter values, never as URLs.

projects.shape: GET projects has a PROJECT_ROLE_ADMIN license gate. Personal binding uses the fixed ID with type personal; other project names remain private. A403 is recorded separately and does not imply authentication failure.

credentials.shape: The metadata list sharing entry uses id for project ID, with name/role/timestamps. Credential data is excluded by the vendor route. Only five exact M03 names, safe IDs and expected types are projected.
credentials.testRouteExistsButNotCalled: POST /api/v1/credentials/{credentialId}/test uses stored data; it is excluded from this GET-only consumer.

workflows.shape: Sharing entries use projectId. The request fixes projectId and excludePinnedData=true. Response nodes, parameters, connections, staticData, meta, active-version contents and pinData are never emitted.
workflows.names: All25 canonical M03 names are cross-checked against packages/shared/src/n8n-bindings.ts only in credential-free local tests.
workflows.manualExecution: No manual execute/run route exists in the reviewed public controller. UI execution remains a separate live acceptance gate.

bounds.tls: Default public CA trust, rejectUnauthorized true, exact fixed hostname and port443; public DNS results are checked and the selected address pinned
bounds.childEnvironment: Fresh OS-only allowlist plus M03_N8N_API_KEY; no database/provider/install credential inherited
bounds.cleanup: Consumed synthetic handoff deleted, BSTR/SecureString disposed, process environment cleared and owned child closure confirmed in tests; separately saved owner key is untouched
bounds.reflectionGuard: Any response value containing the request key fails closed before projection/cursor reuse and clears all projected resources. The consumer independently checks parsed output before accepting it.

remainingGates: Final independent/root source review and public source seal before any real API-key request
